{{Quote|Dad! Roll, ''now''!|Ben Skywalker, to his father, Luke, as the Keshiri Sith attacks him|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Keshiri Sith''' was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. She was chosen to be a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|Sith strike team]] sent to hunt down [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], and [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[43 ABY]]. After the strike team recovered Ship from a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], the Meditation Sphere transported the strike team to [[Sinkhole Station]], where the group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambushed]] Skywalker and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]]. After breaking into the station's control room, the female Keshiri attacked Luke, but Ben quickly [[Cho mai/Legends|sliced off]] her hand with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. She attempted to attack Ben with her own lightsaber, but Ben used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|pull]] her [[Shiak|onto]] his lightsaber blade, killing her.

==Biography==
[[File:Lost_Sith_Tribe_world.jpg|thumb|left|350px|The Keshiri Sith was born on Kesh (pictured).]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] was born on<ref name="Abyss" /> the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="TEA Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. She was [[Sith training|trained]] in the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] with the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]&mdash;descendants of a group of Sith who had crash-landed on Kesh during the days of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Abyss" /> In [[41 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], arrived on Kesh and began to help them form a [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|new armada]].<ref name="Abyss" /> In [[43 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> after the members of the Tribe felt [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] presence in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] when he touched an [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Relics|relic]], the [[Codex]], Ship abruptly left Kesh to follow a call through the Force.<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref> The female Keshiri was chosen by [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]] to be a member of Rhea's [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] sent to recover Ship and eliminate Skywalker.<ref name="Abyss" />

Aboard the captured [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Eternal Crusader]]'', the Keshiri Sith served under Rhea as the strike team tracked Ship to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. There, the team encountered [[Abeloth]], a being who was very strong in the Force and controlled the world's deadly [[Plant/Legends|plant]]-life. Still, many of the strike team's members were [[Death/Legends|killed]] before Ship returned to them, but the female Sith was among the approximately fifteen survivors. Meanwhile, Abeloth had discovered Skywalker and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], at [[Sinkhole Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the Maw. Ship transported the female Keshiri and the other Sith to Sinkhole Station, where they [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambushed]] the Skywalkers. The Keshiri Sith was part of the initial attack group who cut into the station's control room, where the Skywalkers had just returned from going [[beyond shadows]]&mdash;the state of being Force-sensitives entered after separating their minds from their bodies.<ref name="Abyss" />

As the team broke into the control room, the Keshiri Sith threw her [[Parang/Legends|parang]] at Luke, who, with warning from his son, managed to dodge the blade. She tried to [[Telekinesis/Legends|pull]] the weapon back to her with the Force but also sensed Ben moving to attack her, and attempted to counter him while still catching the parang. The complex move failed, and Ben quickly [[Cho mai/Legends|cut off]] her hand with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. She then slashed her own lightsaber at Ben's neck, but he used the Force to pull her body [[Shiak|onto]] his blade, killing her.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Personality and traits==
The Keshiri Sith was strong-willed, as that was one of the criteria for being chosen as a member of the Lost Tribe's strike team.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Powers and abilities==
The Keshiri was Force-sensitive, and she trained in the ways of the Sith with the Lost Tribe on Kesh. In battle she utilized a lightsaber, as well as a parang. She was also the first Sith in the strike team to attack Skywalker during the battle; however, the Jedi's son was able to overcome her defenses instantly, slicing off her hand and stabbing her.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Keshiri Sith appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', a [[2009]] novel written by [[Troy Denning]] that was the third installment of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Abyss" />
